messages.subject: [Epls-r-users] R group this Friday!
messages.body_plain:
Good afternoon all!

The R group will meet this Friday on zoom at 12:00.  We will have an open session this week, so if you have an R project you are working on, come show it off and/or get some help troubleshooting anything you need.

You can access the zoom here:
https://fsu.zoom.us/j/95091562161<https://nam04.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Ffsu.zoom.us%2Fj%2F95091562161&data=05%7C02%7Cepls-r-users%40lists.fsu.edu%7C2f4eee70196b48cad5b208dc85866f56%7Ca36450ebdb0642a78d1b026719f701e3%7C0%7C0%7C638532059636545802%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=A3wq%2FxSeNJlPpNCS2RBuMVeSSlYu87hutGI4c81CpE8%3D&reserved=0>

Or via the R group canvas site.

Hope to see you on Friday!


Kari Roberts
